title: Re-word the worker Result form and the swarming reference to match the departure contract
action: The worker prompt at packages/bee/prompts/worker-cell.md tells every worker what a deviations line must contain; the swarming reference documents the same Result form. Both still describe the free-form one-line value. Re-word them to D5's three required parts and the closed kind set, and to D8's rule that the plain-language sentence is written at the moment of the event rather than composed later. Change wording only — no behaviour, and no promise the code does not keep.

truths: The worker Result form names the three required parts and the closed kind set (D5).
It states that the plain-language sentence is written at the moment of the event, not composed later (D8).
The swarming reference matches the prompt word for word on what a deviations line must carry.
Neither document promises enforcement the code does not have: the requirement is armed-only (D10).
Wording only — no code path changes in this cell.
